about_the_game:
Desktop Engine is an innovative application that redefines the desktop experience, allowing real-time interaction with 2D and 3D characters, chat boxes, avatar systems, and other interactive elements.
Whether you're a streamer, gamer, or just someone who enjoys customizing their desktop — Desktop Engine offers a vibrant, customizable, and interactive desktop environment for everyone.

You can bring characters to life through viewer interactions during live streams, create animated scenes while gaming, or simply build a unique atmosphere on your desktop.

FEATURES

  • 2D & 3D Character Support
    Real-time animated and physics-driven characters on your desktop.

  • Dynamic Physics & Animations
    Default animation sets for humanoid characters (idle, walk, dance, etc.). Realistic physics for hair, skirts, chest, and similar parts.

  • Overlay & Interaction Tools
    Display viewer names and trigger character animations with chat interactions. Ideal for streamers.

  • Personal Use Friendly
    Even if you're not streaming, you can create a personalized desktop scene just for yourself.

  • Extensive Customization
    Easily integrate your own characters and overlay elements. Make your desktop truly yours.

  • Performance-Optimized Design
    Built to conserve system resources while gaming, streaming, or multitasking.

WORKSHOP

With full Steam Workshop support, you can explore and use hundreds of community-created characters, scenes, and overlays.
Looking for something specific? Download and use content shared by others instantly.

Want to create your own? Use the Desktop Engine Editor to publish your creations to the Workshop and share them with the community.

SUPPORTED FILE FORMATS

Character formats:

– .vrm (supports VRoid characters)
– .glb, .fbx

VRM support allows you to use characters created in platforms like VRoid Studio directly in Desktop Engine without needing any conversion.
